subject: VoltLabs founder credit exception & packaging options
messages:
From: Emma Torres <emma@voltlabs.co>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-17T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: founder credits and packaging flexibility for VoltLabs cohort

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile on batch workloads. We're getting our cohort organized for the March accelerator and I wanted to surface two asks to see if Redwood can support them as part of our pilot package: 

1) Founder credit exception: The program expects 6 founding teams; several founders are solo founders with limited payroll and we'd like an extra $6k in free credits across the cohort (on top of the standard $10k per startup) to make sure they can complete model prototyping during month 1.
2) Packaging flexibility: We may convert a subset of cohort usage to a reserved Dedicated instance if we convert to paid after month 2. Can we get an option that allows credit conversion to a discounted committed tier or a credit top-up that applies toward a 3-month reserved commitment?

Our timeline is tight — procurement will want commercial language by Feb 1. Could you share a short proposal and any pricing caveats? I'm looping Ryan (program lead) and procurement for visibility.

Appreciate it —
Emma
Emma Torres
Community Director, VoltLabs
emma@voltlabs.co

Attachment: VoltLabs_MAAP.pdf (program overview, 1 page)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Torres <emma@voltlabs.co>, Ryan Lee <ryan@voltlabs.co>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-17T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: founder credits and packaging flexibility for VoltLabs cohort

Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the MAAP. Quick answers up front, then next steps:

- Founder credit exception: We can approve a one-time cohort-level top-up of $6,000 in free usage credits, subject to a short eligibility checklist (teams must be early-stage, less than $250k ARR, and pass basic abuse/usage screening).
- Credit conversion: We can offer an optional conversion path where unused onboarding credits can be applied toward a Dedicated commitment within 90 days, with a conversion multiplier (credits convert at 60% of face value toward committed spend).

I'll need pricing ops to sign off on the conversion multiplier and to prepare a short addendum. Monica — can you draft the addendum + an eligibility checklist?

Emma/Ryan — if you confirm you want the $6k cohort top-up I can get legal/procurement into a short timeline for Feb 1. Also, can you confirm if any teams will require on-prem (private) deployment during the program?

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
(415) 555-0183

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Emma Torres <emma@voltlabs.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-18T08:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: founder credits and packaging flexibility for VoltLabs cohort

Ben/Emma — drafting the addendum now. A few items I want to confirm to keep legal scope minimal:

- Eligibility: list of teams (names + company email domains) to validate cohort members.
- Abuse/usage screening: we will run standard model-safety and usage checks; no production PII ingestion until onboarding review is completed.
- Conversion mechanics: if VoltLabs elects to convert credits to Dedicated, the remaining credit balance will convert at 60% and must be used toward a 3-month minimum committed spend. Any top-ups must be requested in writing before conversion.

I'm attaching a price grid with two example conversion scenarios and an ops checklist. Marissa — can you confirm the discount cadence for 3-month reserved commits so we can quote the effective price post-conversion?

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Customer Success (Programs)
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
Attachment: pricing_grid_v2.xlsx (ops + conversion examples)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Emma Torres <emma@voltlabs.co>
Date: 2027-01-19T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: founder credits and packaging flexibility for VoltLabs cohort

Hi all — ran numbers with pricing ops. Summary below (high level):

- Approval: $6,000 cohort top-up — approved as a one-off promotional credit.
- Conversion: credits convert at 60% face value toward committed Dedicated spend (3-month minimum). Example: $6k converts to $3,600 of committed spend.
- Dedicated discount: 25% off list for a 3-month committed pool in the pilot region (us-west).

Effective outcomes (two quick scenarios):
- Scenario A: VoltLabs uses $6k in onboarding credits fully — no conversion needed.
- Scenario B: Only $2k used in onboarding; $4k remains and VoltLabs converts the remainder to Dedicated. That $4k converts to $2.4k applied toward a 3-month committed spend; with 25% discount the committed capacity would be priced against the discounted rate, so net economics depend on forecasted month-over-month usage. See attached pricing_grid_v2.xlsx for worked examples.

Emma — if procurement needs language for an invoice or PO-ready addendum, we can publish an addendum that lists the promotional credit amount, eligibility criteria, and conversion mechanics. I recommend keeping the addendum short (1 page) to avoid procurement delays.

Marissa Cole
Pricing & Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Ryan Lee <ryan@voltlabs.co>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@voltlabs.co>, Emma Torres <emma@voltlabs.co>
Date: 2027-01-20T13:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: founder credits and packaging flexibility for VoltLabs cohort

Thanks — this looks good and much appreciated. A couple quick clarifications from procurement: 

- Can the addendum state the conversion multiplier (60%) and the 90-day conversion window explicitly? Procurement wants to see clear timelines.
- Will Redwood accept a PO that references the addendum and apply the credit as a prepayment line item, or do we need a separate credit note?

If you can send the 1-page addendum + a short invoice template that shows the credit as a prepayment line, procurement can process quickly. We'll plan to confirm the cohort list by Jan 25.

Best,
Ryan Lee
Program Director, VoltLabs

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Ryan Lee <ryan@voltlabs.co>, Emma Torres <emma@voltlabs.co>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@voltlabs.co>
Date: 2027-01-20T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: founder credits and packaging flexibility for VoltLabs cohort

Ryan — perfect, we'll get the formal addendum and an invoice template over by EOD tomorrow. Action items: 

- Monica: finalize 1-page addendum (explicitly call out 60% conversion, 90-day window, 3-month committed minimum).
- Marissa: confirm invoice template that allows the credit to be applied as a prepayment line item.
- VoltLabs: confirm cohort roster by Jan 25 so we can run eligibility checks.

On the PO vs credit note question — we can accept a PO referencing the addendum and will apply the promotional credit as a prepayment line on our invoice. If you'd prefer a separate credit note, legal can issue that as well; we typically find PO+invoice faster for our customers.

I'll follow up once I have the addendum and invoice template attached.

Thanks —
Ben
